I melt mine in a glass container inside a small crock pot on low temp over 45 min to an hour. No gritty stuff once it hardens again. Coco butter will form little sand like pellets if you melt it fast. I was buying another brand and thought I'd save a few dollars and try Milliard. First, it's basically powdered. I didn't mind that, as I add it to by Bulletproof coffee. But this cacao butter is not fresh. The smell isn't the same... kind of light in smell and stale overall. No matter how I used it, it never tasted right or good.  I would definitely stay away from this. Stale product is just a waste of money.
We have been making our own chocolate so that we can have organic chocolate w/o any sugar,  with stevia and lohan for sweeteners and this Millard Organic Raw Cacao butter is great!.

I've used this for both baking and making lotion, and it works great for both.  It has a nice taste and smell. It seems to be very good quality and the packaging is resealable and seems to keep it good and fresh.
Very good product ... especially for the price!  Loved the quality and their packaging was great at protecting the product thru shipment and now use.

reviews.t: There was glass in here. I used this to ...
reviews.x: There was glass in here. I used this to make chocolate and feed it to my kids only to have glass in my mouth. Do not purchase!!!

reviews.t: Thank you Milliard for a great product.
reviews.x: After ordering product (raw cocoa butter), it arrived in the appropriate time frame.  Upon opening, my product was packaged properly, no damage or defects visually.  We opened the cocoa butter that ordered.  We found it to be fresh and very very aromatic.  It filled our house with the scent of cocoa.  We used our purchase of cocoa butter to make homemade dark chocolate.  The chocolates tasted great.  Thank you Milliard.  We would have no problems ordering from Milliard again.
The smell is heavenly!  Very fresh and adds a silky taste to your hot chocolate or any of your chocolate recipes.  Keep it in the refrigerator for best freshness.

Only thing is, it is labeled as Raw Cocoa Butter on the bag and it says it's Raw Cacao Butter on the title and shipping label... Since this was left at my doorstep by the delivery guy it melted in the florida heat. I'm not upset, heat melts stuff, it happens. I've been mixing this into a lot of things I make, including my homemade nut butters... oh my word... soooo goood!! Great price too if you compare to other brands. Will probably re-purchase!
Very nice cacao butter.  I used them in lotion bars and the smell is amazing!
makes great white & dark chocolate. Fresh & high quality.

I believe I got it too hot when I put the vanilla in and it turned gritty.  Then I read a little more about making the chocolate and made sure the cacao butter mixture was much cooler and it turned out fine.  I made milk chocolate with it too and it turned out just as good if not better than what you buy in the stores.  I wou

reviews.t: Quality product at a reasonable price.
reviews.x: This is the best deal I have found on Amazon without compromising on quality. I add a couple of small chunks to my coffee (along with some unsalted grass fed butter, MCT oil, and a little vanilla powder) each morning and blend it for a few seconds. Do this without sugar and you have a delicious healthy breakfast alternative that will keep you going 'till lunch.

I like this cacao butter. It smells heavenly. I've tasted it and it is yummy but I haven't made truffles yet. I did make some body lotion by mixing cacao butter, shea butter and coconut butter together. It turns out like whip cream and makes my skin feel great. I believe cacao butter is very healthy for my skin and this brand seems pure.

I have used this for lip balm and body balm.  It smells wonderful, melts well and holds together well when mixed with the other ingredients in the balm.  Will continue to use.  Highly recommend. When it arrives, it comes in chunks that you have to cut - but they cut easily with a sharp knife.  You will like this product.

I use this to make homemade chocolate - works great. The only thing is, their nutritional info is off - it says there are 50 grams of carbs in a serving. I have tried to contact Milliard and cannot find any info on them, which is really puzzling. Anyway, cacao butter has no carbs, it's all fat.

reviews.t: Exceptional Cocao Butter - From a Professional Chocolate Maker
reviews.x: This stuff is fantastic!!  I work in a confectionary lab as an R&D scientist, and I use this all the time in my chocolate prototypes.  For raw cocao butter, it has a very pleasant aroma, and gives an extra silky, "melt-in-your-mouth" quality to the chocolates I create.

reviews.t: I love the way this stuff smells
reviews.x: I love the way this stuff smells. I didn't notice much difference in my skin, but it's a good natural alternative for all the chemical laden skin care products out there. It's quite hard, so I just rub some between my hands until it melts. It's also good for making lip balms.

reviews.t: I loved using this and loves the smell of my house ...
reviews.x: I am unable to purchase this product in any stores around my house so I came here. I loved using this and loves the smell of my house while melting it. My sister in law loves raw desserts and I wanted to surprise her with a nice cake. It turned out awesome!

reviews.t: Is there a better tasting fat that isn't animal based?
reviews.x: I'm using this as a fat source in my morning coffee along with some butter and MCT oil.  Great stuff.  I've always loved cacao butter, being a huge white chocolate fan as a child, so it would be really difficult for me not to love this product.

I haven't tried baking with it yet as I was waiting to try it out for a recipe on Thanksgiving so I will update this later. I did snack on a few pieces and it melts so smoothly in your mouth. The aroma is amazing too! So chocolatey!
I was in such a hurry, so I thought this was like regular cocoa powder only organic raw. Forgot the days when I prevented stretch marks with cocoa butter. Great for that!! Just not what I wanted!

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product as fresh, high quality, and great smelling, especially for making chocolate and body products.
Several reviewers find it a good value for the price compared to other brands.
A few reviewers report negative experiences, including a stale smell and a serious safety issue with glass found in the product.
Some reviewers note melting or texture issues, such as grittiness when overheated or melting in transit.
One reviewer questions the accuracy of the nutrition label regarding carbohydrate content.
